channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Hello Houston (February 5, 2026)
item.description: Today: Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller discusses his re-election campaign, we learn about the ACE Houston mentoring program, and talk with sportscaster Raheel Ramzanali about the upcoming Super Bowl.

item.title: Amid financial crunch, Houston police and fire projected to overshoot OT budgets by more than $50 million
item.description: Police and fire department officials attributed the excess overtime spending to an inadequate number of personnel and unexpected weather events.

item.title: Nonprofit Trees for Houston plants its millionth tree
item.description: Houston Matters visits the celebration and planting of the organization's millionth tree in the region and talks with executive director, Barry Ward.

item.title: A floor at the Harris County Jail could be converted into a medical wing to bolster inmate services
item.description: Representatives of the Harris County Sheriff's Office told state commissioners on Thursday they plan to create a medical division for the first time in the history of the downtown Houston jail, where 20 inmates died in jail custody last year.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 5, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters – we have “The Commuter Cut” – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Tom Hanks on the Artemis missions and why going back to the moon matters
item.description: Actor Tom Hanks talks about how his fascination with space began as a child and what humans will accomplish by returning to the moon with the Artemis program.

item.title: Houston-based organ transplant doctor federally indicted for allegedly falsifying records
item.description: Dr. J. Steve Bynon surrendered to federal authorities following an investigation into the allegations that led to a months-long halt of Houston-based Memorial Hermann's kidney and liver transplant programs. Bynon was set to appear before a U.S. magistrate judge on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Dallas man accused of kidnapping, sexually assaulting 12-year-old Galveston girl
item.description: The girl told police investigators that Graham Dunn, 27, allegedly forced her into his car and stopped her from leaving by pulling her hair.

item.title: Cy-Fair ISD superintendent says Greg Abbott’s demands regarding Islamic Games contained ‘inaccuracies’
item.description: Douglas Killian told the governor the Houston-area school district "has nothing to hide" after Abbott demanded that Cy-Fair ISD sever its ties with the Houston Islamic Games, which are slated to be held in the fall.

item.title: Voters with disabilities sue Harris County for allegedly lacking inclusive vote-by-mail options
item.description: A group of voters, alongside the national Federation of the Blind of Texas, say the only options for them to vote by mail require assistance from someone with sight, preventing them from casting a ballot in private.
